meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 装上后,你给出网址、GitHub 仓库、PDF、视频等资料,Claude 会自动判断来源类型,调用对应工具抓取,并打包成 AI 技能,还能按需导出到向量数据库。
howto.when: 当你想用文档站点、GitHub 仓库、PDF 等资料新建或更新技能时,它会接管并自动判断该走哪条抓取流程。

say.text: 把这个文档网址 https://... 做成一个技能
say.note: 识别为文档站点并抓取打包

say.text: 用 owner/repo 这个仓库生成技能
把这份 PDF 转成技能并导出到 Chroma
say.note: 抓取后导出到向量数据库

howto.what_en: Once installed, you give Claude a URL, GitHub repo, PDF, video, or other source; it detects the source type, scrapes it with the matching tool, and builds an AI skill you can package or export to a vector DB.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to create or update a skill from a documentation site, GitHub repo, PDF, video, or similar source.

say_en.text: Turn this docs URL https://... into a skill
say_en.note: Detected as docs, scraped and packaged

say_en.text: Build a skill from the repo owner/repo
Convert this PDF into a skill and export it to Chroma
say_en.note: Scrapes, then exports to a vector DB
